blocks.text: MANILA — Leyte 1st District Rep. Martin Romualdez on Monday asked the Sandiganbayan to grant him temporary liberty while his plunder case is pending before the anti-graft court. Romualdez’s defense counsel Ade Fajardo said the former Speaker insists he is not a flight risk. READ: Martin Romualdez, former House Speaker, pleads not guilty to plunder He is currently detained at the Quezon City Jail in Payatas after the court rejected his plea to be detained in a hospital. The Sandiganbayan ordered Romualdez’ arrest last Sept. 7, and he was arraigned last Sept. 25. The bail hearing was scheduled for Oct. 12. […]...
